blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Monumental city gates, industrial hangar thresholds, temple forecourts, palace courtyards, train-shed entrances, and settlements built into the remains of structures created at a much larger scale.
World relation: Open World civic reuse with Continuity embodied in the surviving threshold. Pilgrim meaning survives because the door remains a place of arrival even after the destination changes.
Connection to newer locations: Doorway Plaza connects to the Urban Canyon Hive, Museum of Unfinished Rooms, Monsoon Stepwell City, and Last City of Many Forms.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: Scale is historical. What one civilization treated as a doorway can become another civilization’s entire public square without the later use being lesser.
